claim_type: General engineering performance or platform claim
evidence_risk: The manuscript demonstrates a prototype or limited operating regime but phrases the result as broadly general.
reviewer_concern: A reader cannot tell which claims are directly demonstrated and which are extrapolated beyond the test matrix.
revision_direction: Calibrate the abstract, title and discussion to the validated envelope; state unresolved scaling and deployment constraints.

evidence_risk: Only favourable metrics are highlighted while trade-offs such as power, yield, lifetime, complexity or safety are underweighted.
reviewer_concern: The claimed advance may disappear under a complete multi-objective comparison.
revision_direction: Report a balanced metric table and explicitly discuss performance trade-offs against closest alternatives.

pattern_name: Insufficient separation from closest prior art
claim_type: Novel device, platform, method or architecture
evidence_risk: The closest previous systems are not compared under equivalent definitions or conditions.
reviewer_concern: The claimed conceptual advance may be an incremental combination or implementation detail.
revision_direction: Add a focused comparison with the nearest prior art and specify what is new in principle, capability or scale.

evidence_risk: The work is novel to one community but routine in another domain whose literature is not represented.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript may overclaim originality because it samples only a narrow citation field.
revision_direction: Map the contribution against the relevant materials, controls, robotics, bioengineering or computation literature as appropriate.

claim_type: System design solves a practical engineering problem
evidence_risk: Functional requirements, constraints and acceptance criteria are implicit rather than quantitatively defined.
reviewer_concern: It is unclear whether the proposed design is optimized for the claimed use case or merely works in a permissive setting.
revision_direction: Define requirements before presenting results, including target operating range, tolerances, safety constraints and success thresholds.

pattern_name: Component-level success treated as system-level validation
evidence_risk: Individual modules are characterized, but integration losses and system interactions are not tested.
reviewer_concern: Component performance may not transfer to the assembled device or workflow.
revision_direction: Add end-to-end system tests and account for losses, delays, coupling effects and failure propagation.

claim_type: Mechanism, material, device or bioengineering effect
evidence_risk: The experiment lacks controls that isolate the active design element from confounders.
reviewer_concern: Observed improvements may be caused by fabrication history, geometry, training protocol or environmental conditions rather than the proposed mechanism.
revision_direction: Add matched controls and ablations that remove or perturb the claimed causal design feature.

evidence_risk: Key results rely on few devices, cells, robots, samples or experimental runs.
reviewer_concern: The magnitude and repeatability of the effect are not distinguishable from run-to-run variability.
revision_direction: Report biological or technical replicates, failure counts, variance and confidence intervals for principal claims.

evidence_risk: Validation is performed under simplified laboratory conditions that omit load, contamination, heterogeneity, motion, ageing or deployment stress.
reviewer_concern: The use-case claim is stronger than the environmental realism of the tests.
revision_direction: Add tests under representative operating conditions or narrow the deployment claim accordingly.

evidence_risk: Baselines are not tuned, not current, or evaluated under different data, hardware or operating conditions.
reviewer_concern: Performance superiority may be an artefact of comparison design.
revision_direction: Use current baselines, matched constraints and transparent evaluation protocols; report where each method is advantaged or disadvantaged.

evidence_risk: Latency, efficiency, sensitivity, accuracy, stability, throughput or yield are not defined consistently.
reviewer_concern: Readers cannot reproduce or compare the reported performance.
revision_direction: Define every metric, denominator, time window and normalization; align tables and figures with those definitions.

claim_type: Scalable manufacturing, deployment or throughput claim
evidence_risk: The work extrapolates from small devices or short demonstrations without considering yield, cost, parallelization, heat, mass transport or control complexity.
reviewer_concern: Scaling may introduce new dominant limitations not present in the proof-of-concept.
revision_direction: Provide a scale-up analysis or explicitly restrict the claim to the demonstrated size and throughput.

evidence_risk: Performance is reported at one or a few operating points rather than across the relevant envelope.
reviewer_concern: The reported result may be a narrow optimum rather than a robust capability.
revision_direction: Map performance over load, speed, temperature, humidity, concentration, duration, geometry or dataset shift as appropriate.

evidence_risk: A simulation or optimization result is used as if it independently validates the physical system.
reviewer_concern: The model may encode assumptions that determine the conclusion.
revision_direction: Separate model prediction from experimental validation; test sensitivity to assumptions and parameters.

evidence_risk: Important parameters are fitted, selected or fixed without uncertainty propagation.
reviewer_concern: The model may not be predictive outside the calibration set.
revision_direction: Disclose parameter sources, fitting strategy and sensitivity; test on independent data or unseen conditions.

evidence_risk: Key metrics are plotted without error bars, sample sizes, confidence intervals or failure rates.
reviewer_concern: It is impossible to judge whether differences are meaningful and reproducible.
revision_direction: Report n, variance, error model and failure statistics for each major metric.

evidence_risk: Aggregate performance masks catastrophic, rare or condition-specific failures.
reviewer_concern: The manuscript does not show when the design fails or how failure affects the claimed application.
revision_direction: Include failure taxonomy, worst-case cases, survival/lifetime tests or stress tests matched to the intended use.

claim_type: Mechanistic explanation of an engineering effect
evidence_risk: The manuscript shows a correlation between design parameters and output but does not perturb the causal pathway.
reviewer_concern: The proposed mechanism may be plausible but not demonstrated.
revision_direction: Add targeted perturbations, ablations, intermediate measurements or competing-mechanism tests.

claim_type: Physical, chemical or biological mechanism claim
evidence_risk: Alternative mechanisms could explain the same performance trend.
reviewer_concern: The central explanatory claim is underdetermined by the evidence.
revision_direction: State alternative explanations and add discriminating experiments or narrow the claim to phenomenology.

evidence_risk: Only selected devices or batches are reported; yield and batch-to-batch variation are absent.
reviewer_concern: The device performance may depend on unreported fabrication variability.
revision_direction: Report process window, yield, rejected devices, batch statistics and critical fabrication tolerances.

claim_type: Long-lived material, device or implant performance
evidence_risk: Tests do not capture interface degradation, fouling, fatigue, hysteresis, drift or environmental ageing.
reviewer_concern: Short-term performance may not support lifetime or deployment claims.
revision_direction: Add accelerated ageing, cyclic tests, post-test characterization or restrict lifetime claims.

pattern_name: Controller tested only in permissive environments
evidence_risk: Robots are evaluated in simple arenas, limited tasks or hand-curated scenarios.
reviewer_concern: The controller may not be robust to perturbations, terrain, contact dynamics or distribution shift.
revision_direction: Add perturbation tests, task diversity, held-out environments and comparisons to simpler control policies.

claim_type: Robot morphology or embodied intelligence claim
evidence_risk: The study does not separate hardware morphology, sensing, actuation and control algorithm contributions.
reviewer_concern: The claimed design principle may be attributable to one subsystem or to tuning rather than embodiment.
revision_direction: Use ablations and matched controllers/morphologies to isolate the contribution of each subsystem.

claim_type: Biomedical device, implant, therapeutic or diagnostic claim
evidence_risk: The evidence is limited to in vitro or short animal studies but the claims imply clinical or translational readiness.
reviewer_concern: Safety, immune response, off-target effects, biodistribution, durability or manufacturing controls remain unresolved.
revision_direction: Use cautious translational language and add relevant safety, dose-response, durability or in vivo controls.

claim_type: Bioengineering performance in cells, tissues or organisms
evidence_risk: Cell line, animal model, patient-like heterogeneity or biological confounders are not sufficiently specified.
reviewer_concern: The engineering effect may not generalize across biological contexts.
revision_direction: Clarify biological model choice and test representative heterogeneity where it is central to the claim.

claim_type: Autonomous laboratory, AI scientist or self-driving system claim
evidence_risk: Human intervention, curated search space or hard-coded constraints are not separated from autonomous decision-making.
reviewer_concern: The system may be automated execution rather than autonomous discovery or reasoning.
revision_direction: Disclose human inputs, constraints, stopping rules and decision logic; compare against manual or non-adaptive baselines.

evidence_risk: Training, tuning, benchmark selection or prompt engineering may contaminate evaluation.
reviewer_concern: The reported gain may not transfer to unseen designs, tasks or laboratories.
revision_direction: Use held-out tasks, disclose tuning protocol, separate development and evaluation sets, and include strong non-AI baselines.

evidence_risk: Critical materials, process parameters, calibration steps, code or data are unavailable or under-specified.
reviewer_concern: A competent reader could not reproduce the core result.
revision_direction: Provide executable code, raw/processed data, full protocols, calibration details and versioned dependencies where possible.

pattern_name: Unavailable negative results or selection criteria
evidence_risk: The manuscript reports successful designs but not failed trials, exclusion criteria or selection filters.
reviewer_concern: The apparent efficiency or reliability may be biased by selective reporting.
revision_direction: Report screening funnel, failed variants, exclusion criteria and all material/device/sample counts.

claim_type: Quantitative interpretation based on visual evidence
evidence_risk: Figures show qualitative examples while text uses them to make quantitative or general claims.
reviewer_concern: The evidence anchor for major claims is unclear or insufficiently quantified.
revision_direction: Add quantitative summaries, sample sizes, units, axis definitions and source-data links for claim-bearing figures.

evidence_risk: Definitions, symbols, units or abbreviations vary across the manuscript, figures and supplement.
reviewer_concern: Ambiguity prevents evaluation of methods and comparison with prior work.
revision_direction: Standardize definitions, add notation tables and ensure captions carry all units and measurement conditions.

evidence_risk: A device paper reports an impressive exemplar but not yield across fabricated units.
reviewer_concern: The conclusion may be stronger than the demonstrated engineering evidence.
revision_direction: Report unit counts, process yield, failed devices and batch-level variability.

evidence_risk: Durability tests are shorter or milder than the claimed deployment regime.
reviewer_concern: The conclusion may be stronger than the demonstrated engineering evidence.
revision_direction: Extend cycling, stress or storage tests and state practical lifetime limits.

evidence_risk: The robot succeeds in one task class but the title implies general manipulation, locomotion or autonomy.
reviewer_concern: The conclusion may be stronger than the demonstrated engineering evidence.
revision_direction: Add task diversity and failure analysis or narrow the robot capability claim.

evidence_risk: Simulation performance is emphasized without enough real-world transfer evidence.
reviewer_concern: The conclusion may be stronger than the demonstrated engineering evidence.
revision_direction: Report sim-to-real assumptions, real-world trials and domain randomization or adaptation details.

evidence_risk: Efficacy endpoints are stronger than toxicity, immune, off-target or durability endpoints.
reviewer_concern: The conclusion may be stronger than the demonstrated engineering evidence.
revision_direction: Add safety endpoints matched to the proposed biomedical application.

evidence_risk: Autonomous discovery claims depend on a manually restricted search space.
reviewer_concern: The conclusion may be stronger than the demonstrated engineering evidence.
revision_direction: Make the search-space design explicit and compare adaptive against non-adaptive search.
